from.place: Proof paragraph 2, middle derived mapping-complex comparison before the inverse limit: Infinity-categorical monadicity and the augmented counit bar resolution. Supporting foundation: Free coherent monad modules and their augmented free resolution. Supporting lemma: Underlying equivalences and operadic colimits of coherent modules. Supporting step: Colimits of sections from preserved local fiber cocones. Fiber-to-relative-colimit criterion used before assembling the chosen cocones.

title: Relative colimits in a fiber tested by all local transports
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, colimits and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], relative colimit diagrams and right join cones of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone], and inner and cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $q:E\to S$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories such that its pullback along each edge $a:\Delta^1\to S$ is a cocartesian fibration. For a vertex $s$ put $E_s=E\times_S\{s\}$. For an edge $a:s\to t$, a transport functor for $a$ is a functor $a_!:E_s\to E_t$ for which there is a simplicial map $H:E_s\times\Delta^1\to E\times_{S,a}\Delta^1$ over $\Delta^1$ with $H|_{E_s\times\{0\}}$ the inclusion, $H|_{E_s\times\{1\}}=a_!$, and every edge $H|_{\{x\}\times\Delta^1}$ cocartesian for the edge pullback. Let $K$ be any small simplicial set and $c:K^{\triangleright}\to E_s$ any diagram. For a diagram $u:K^{\triangleright}\to E_t$ with cone vertex $v$, its induced coherent cocone $u|_K\to\Delta_Ku(v)$ is the precomposition of $u$ with the map $K\times\Delta^1\to K^{\triangleright}$ that sends a simplex $(\sigma,\alpha)$, $\alpha:[n]\to[1]$, to the join simplex whose initial block is $\sigma$ restricted to $\alpha^{-1}(0)$ and whose final block is $\alpha^{-1}(1)$ at the cone vertex. Then the composite $K^{\triangleright}\xrightarrow{c}E_s\hookrightarrow E$ is a $q$-colimit diagram if and only if, for every edge $a:s\to t$ of $S$ and every transport functor $a_!$ for $a$, the induced coherent cocone of $a_!c$ is colimiting in $E_t$. Degenerate edges are included. No other colimits are assumed; neither global cocartesian lifts nor coherence of transports under composition is assumed. All objects lie in a fixed sufficiently large universe.
